picks.title: Teen founder reveals 'personal AI computer' that's a $3,499 Mac mini rival
picks.rationale: New dedicated local-agent hardware (Ghost Core, RTX PRO 4000) that pitches a subscription-free, always-on AI box, a fresh device category angle.
picks.excerpt: Ghost's Core 'builds context on your life over time and works continuously to help you' while offering tight security and privacy.

picks.title: Google AI Edge Foresight for Mac turns scribbles into full notes using offline recordings
picks.rationale: Google ships EmbeddingGemma 2 with an offline on-device notetaking Mac app, a concrete new release for on-device AI.
picks.excerpt: Google today announced EmbeddingGemma 2. To show off its potential, Google created an AI Edge Foresight Mac app for "intelligent notetaking."

picks.title: Google's new Fitbit could make you rethink buying a smartwatch
picks.rationale: Rumored Fitbit Edge tracker built around Gemini coaching, a sign that Google's AI health coach is moving onto low-cost dedicated wearables.
picks.excerpt: Google’s rumored Fitbit Edge could pack a screen, GPS, Gemini coaching, and week-long battery life into one tiny tracker.

picks.title: JBL's New Party Speaker Has an AI Karaoke Feature You May Actually Want to Use
picks.rationale: New consumer audio product with on-device AI vocal stem separation, a practical AI feature in a mainstream gadget.
picks.excerpt: The PartyBox Ultimate 2 uses JBL's AI tool to strip vocals from your songs.

picks.title: Silicon Valley's AI wunderkind launches Underdog, the most private Instinct/Muse competitor yet
picks.rationale: Launch of a free, fully on-device personal AI assistant positioned against Meta Muse, a new product release rather than more Muse coverage.
picks.excerpt: Sigil Wen, backed by a Silicon Valley who's who, has built an on-device AI assistant that promises to be free, fully private, and capable for everyday tasks.
